tagline: Context-aware sticky notes on any business document with pins, mentions, and reminders
problem: Critical customer context is buried in chatter, spreadsheets, or personal notebooks instead of the document users are working on.
solution: Attach colorful sticky notes to sale orders, invoices, CRM leads, contacts, products, and more with pins, mentions, templates, and reminders.
benefits: Keep payment warnings and VIP flags visible on the record
Mention teammates without leaving the form
Fast OWL panel without opening chatter

features.title: Context-aware
features.text: Notes stay attached to the exact business document you are viewing.

features.title: Pinned cards
features.text: Pin critical warnings so they always appear first.

features.title: Mentions
features.text: Notify teammates when they are mentioned on a note.

features.title: Templates
features.text: Admins define VIP, payment delay, and delivery call templates.

workflow: Open a sale order or invoice
Add or pin a note from the panel
Mention a teammate or set a reminder

faq.q: Which documents are supported in V1?
faq.a: Sale orders, purchase orders, invoices, CRM leads, contacts, products, and employees.
Yes. Set visibility to Only Me, Sales Team, Managers, or Everyone.
